title: Beach Day at JBR
intro: Yesterday Riya's family spent the day at the beach. Tell the story in the past tense.

sections.title: Write the past tense of each verb.
Fill in the blank with the past tense of the word in brackets.

items.q: Mama ___ (buy) mango ice cream for everyone.
I ___ (swim) in the shallow water with Papa.
We ___ (walk) back to the car at sunset.

items.after: a pink shell near the rocks.
very tired after the long day.

sections.title: Change each sentence to the past tense.

items.q: I eat a cheese sandwich under the umbrella.
items.a: I ate a cheese sandwich under the umbrella.

items.q: The seagulls fly over the water.
items.a: The seagulls flew over the water.

sections.title: Write two sentences about the last time you went out. Use the past tense.
sections.a: Answers will vary. Check that every action word is in the past tense.
